activity.notes: Choe Yeong was a major late-Goryeo commander. ATLAS uses his source-attested leadership of the 1376 Battle of Hongsan, a representative victory over Wokou forces, as a conservative representative Activity rather than expanding across his entire military career.

sources.title: 홍산대첩
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture states that Choe Yeong led the Goryeo victory over Wokou at Hongsan in July 1376.
